source.quote: Covered systems that reach high capability must have safeguards that sufficiently minimize the associated risk of severe harm before they are deployed. Systems that reach critical capability also require safeguards that sufficiently minimize associated risks during development.
source.title: TechCrunch: OpenAI may 'adjust' its safeguards if rivals release 'high-risk' AI

events.speaker: OpenAI
events.speakerCapacity: Official Preparedness Framework v2 blog post (quoted by TechCrunch)
events.summary: In the updated Preparedness Framework (v2), OpenAI committed that systems assessed at High capability must have risk-minimizing safeguards before deployment, and Critical-capability systems during development. The framework also reserves the right to adjust requirements if a rival releases a high-risk system without comparable safeguards — only after rigorous confirmation, public acknowledgment, and keeping safeguards 'at a level more protective.'

events.author: research-agent

source.quote: We decided to treat the "GPT‑5 thinking" model as High capability in the Biological and Chemical domain, and have implemented strong safeguards to sufficiently minimize the associated risks.
source.title: OpenAI: Introducing GPT-5

events.summary: OpenAI applied the framework in practice: GPT-5 thinking was assessed at High capability in the Biological and Chemical domain and shipped with the required safeguards (multilayered biology safety stack, 5,000 hours of red-teaming with CAISI/UK AISI partners).

events.author: research-agent

source.title: TechCrunch: OpenAI may 'adjust' its safeguards if rivals release 'high-risk' AI

events.summary: Open and holding so far. The framework remains in force and was applied to GPT-5 (High bio/chem, safeguards activated). A breach would be any covered system assessed at High/Critical shipping without the required safeguards, or a competitive-standards adjustment made without the promised public acknowledgment.

lineages.fulfillmentTest: No covered system assessed at High or Critical capability is deployed without the safeguards the Preparedness Framework v2 requires, and the framework remains in force. A deployment of a High/Critical system without published safeguards — or a quiet standards-lowering under the competitive-adjustment clause — fails the test.
lineages.title: Preparedness Framework v2: safeguards before deployment at High/Critical capability
